prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium visual concept board showing a 8x social website video section AND a small three-frame motion storyboard below it. Landscape 1536x1280. Main website screenshot occupies upper 78%, storyboard lower22%. Brand is extremely minimal black, warm stone, small vermilion accents. The user rejected static arrangements of different-sized video cards. This concept MUST clearly communicate one unified responsive GLOW FIELD made from a regular equal-sized video grid. It must look fundamentally different from a large hero video surrounded by smaller cards. All video cells EXACTLY same size. No centerpiece, no giant portrait. A moving soft spotlight links the clips as a single living material.

Five input images are source-footage references: man with microphone, guitarist, man in brown hoodie, laptop demo, woman with pink nails. Use these authentic subjects in five cells. Other cells are illustrative candid UGC video scenes: a woman speaking outside, hands showing a phone app, a person working at a desk, a man speaking into phone, product unboxing, woman recording at home, another product demonstration. Natural smartphone footage, realistic natural lighting, varied people. Avoid duplicated faces. This is a visual mockup, not a claim about real creators or results. Small native source captions can remain only on the supplied video references; NO invented testimonial text or metrics.

MAIN WEBSITE: continuous flat warm stone #e9e5dc. Quiet navbar with black serif '8x' small sans 'social' onleft, textlinks 'The network', 'How it works', 'For creators', 'Let’s talk ↗' onright. Calm white space, precise grid.
A bold compact editorial heading at left 'A network.' on firstline, 'Always in motion.' on secondline, black modern sans with tight tracking, final dot vermilion. Right short black supporting copy: 'The right creators. Content that keeps moving. One team behind it all.' Under it restrained 'Build your network ↗' text link. No framed headerbox.

Below, show ONE unified rectangular video FIELD of TWELVE equal-sized portrait9:16 clips, 6columns x2rows. Consistent 14px narrow dark/stone gaps, all front facing, exact geometry, no tilt, no perspective, no overlap, no stagger, no individual drop shadows or rounded cards. Approx overallwidth1180, height690 at this composition scale, adapted to fit screenshot. Every clip same brightness baseline, softly desaturated and dimmed enough to create a coherent charcoal mosaic againststone. Faces still readable, never make ten cells black. Thin restrained dothalftone at the OUTERMOST perimeter of the ENTIRE video field, dissolving into stone. No dotted border around eachvideo. Tiny dots in the gaps faintly connect the whole field.

The signature effect: one broad feathered elliptical band of warm white and apricot light currently crossing diagonally through left-middle to upper-right of the mosaic. The light is derived from selected videos' colours and softly spills through the narrow gutters: center2-3 clips lift into natural full colour, adjacentclips lift justslightly, the rest stays charcoal-desaturated. This light softly illuminates the sparse dotfield beside the mosaic. Light looks like a restrained luminous reflection and moving focus, NOT electric borders. No neon outlines, lasers, sci-fi HUD, rainbowwash, lightning, glowingrings, gaudy gold. The glow should be visible and gorgeous but highly refined. It changes the perceptual focus of an equal-size grid without changing card sizes. Clean glossy editorial installation, beautiful warmcolour accents in filmedfaces, minimal website presentation.
Belowfield small quiet line: 'Creators, content and publishing. Managed by 8x.' On right 'TikTok · Instagram · YouTube Shorts'. No three featurecards or additionalstats.

STORYBOARD: outside website mock, on same stone, generous whitespace separation and no horizontal divider. Three miniatures of EXACT SAME equal-sized12-video grid at three moments, each with tiny numbered label above: '01 / GATHER', '02 / LIGHT TRAVELS', '03 / FOLLOW YOUR CURSOR'. First miniature has light on left2cells, secondhas lightcenter/diagonal, thirdlightupperright with one understated cursor. Clearly different focus areas, not different video sizes. A thin minimal curved directionarrow belowminiatures can imply movement, not inside website. Small board footnote 'Slow shared glow. Fixed frames. Subtle dotted edges.' These miniatures illustrate how interaction works so image doesn't just look static.

Overall restraint and finesse: ample outer margins, tidy exact alignment, no clipped content. No huge typography competing with videos. No background colour change betweensections, no sectionboxes. Black/stone remain90%ofgraphic palette, colourfromfootage andone localizedapricotglow. Provide finished highresolution design, not wireframe.
